cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on the prize! Come beside me; I'll present it. What a lovely year for judges willing to be surprised.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you saying I didn't deserve it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not at all. You may be proud of how far they've stretched their idea of excellence for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just say 'well done' when you hand it over?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Well done. Hold it a little higher; I'll make sure everyone sees how warmly I welcome the entry that finished just ahead of mine.

reason: Make A direct the presentation while maintaining explicit congratulations and well done, with resentment rooted in B narrow victory over A rather than abstract effort at complimenting.
